title: GTA 6 Publisher Take-Two Confirms Digital Sales Over 90%
description: GTA 6 publisher Take-Two revises its 2027 net bookings up to $8.2bn, with CEO Strauss Zelnick confirming that sales are well over 90% digital.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Take-Two Revises Financials and Net Bookings

As the gaming community eagerly anticipates the arrival of GTA 6, parent company Take-Two Interactive continues to make waves with its latest financial updates. According to a recent report by Eurogamer, Take-Two has updated its financials and revised its net bookings projection for 2027 up to $8.2bn.

## The Shift to Digital Distribution

During the latest financial call, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick addressed the evolving landscape of physical versus digital media. In response to Sony's recent controversial decision to stop manufacturing physical disc-based games, Zelnick highlighted how far the publisher's business model has already shifted.

> "Our business is well over 90% digitally distributed," Zelnick stated during the call. "It's already a digital business."

This high percentage of digital distribution underscores a broader industry trend toward a disc-free future. For a blockbuster release like GTA 6, dominating the digital marketplace will be a crucial factor in shaping modern gaming commerce and revenue milestones.

## Editor's Take

Take-Two's confirmation that its business is well over 90% digital highlights an irreversible shift in the gaming industry. As anticipation builds for GTA 6, this heavy reliance on digital distribution sets a clear precedent for how massive AAA titles will launch and distribute moving forward.
